jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. The Opportunity As Head of Design, you will shape how people understand, direct and work with autonomous robots in some of the world’s most demanding industrial environments. This is not a conventional software design leadership role. Our products combine mobile robotics, operator interfaces, autonomous behaviour, inspection workflows and complex 3D data to support the people who plan, perform and act on industrial inspections. There are still few established design patterns for bringing these elements together into one intuitive, trusted experience. You will help create them. Today, our design capability spans UX/UI, product design, industrial design and future concept development across several teams. You will bring these disciplines together, establish a coherent design direction across the full product ecosystem and remain hands-on in solving the hardest design challenges. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Advanced Technology and our customer-facing teams. You will also spend time with customers and users in the industrial environments where our robots operate, ensuring that the experiences we pioneer solve real problems for the people who rely on them. Your Impact Lead and develop a multidisciplinary design team, setting clear goals, raising the quality bar and creating the conditions for strong designers to do their best work. Build understanding of the value of design across the organisation and strengthen the partnership between Product, Design and Engineering. Define a unified design vision across the physical robot, digital products, spatial interfaces and the end-to-end customer experience. jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Driving product initiatives with founders and engineers. Help frame the problem, facilitate decisions and turn a direction into projects and tasks the team can execute. Making the product coherent as it grow

jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world. What You'll Work On Build end-to-end production workflows that push FLUX to its limits — experiments, visual explorations, and pieces tailored to brand, agency, and entertainment use cases that show what's possible before anyone else figures it out. Test and explore models, endpoints, and features that are still in development — you're the one figuring out what they can actually do, and turning that into new insights for image, video generation and more Create and maintain a library of demo boards, templates, and pipelines that make the product's value obvious in live pitches. Partner with Sales and FDEs on discovery and demo prep, and document what works so it scales across the team. Support customer enablement - help define what's feasible for custom projects, fine-tuning, and creative workflows. jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it. We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career. If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you. Your Impact Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger. A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth.
